title: I do want to thank @anildash @megatronn5 and the entire @glitch team for helping with the transition from @mozilla thimble. When you build technology
summary: I do want to thank @anildash @megatronn5 and the entire @glitch team for helping with the transition from @mozilla thimble. When you build technology on open standards portability isn't a concern. And when values of open support a community the world grows.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: I do want to thank @anildash @megatronn5 and the entire @glitch team for helping with the transition from @mozilla thimble. When you build technology on open standards portability isn't a concern. And when values of open support a community the world grows.
